title: Developing Agricultural Pest Management Strategies with Reduced Risks to Surface Water: An Economic Case Study of California's Central Coast Region
abstract: Pesticides are critical for protecting agricultural crops, but the off-site transport of these materials via spray drift and runoff poses risks to surface waters and aquatic life. California's Central Coast region is a major agricultural hub in the United States characterized by year-round production and intensive use of pesticides and other chemical inputs. As a result, the quality of many waterbodies in the region has been degraded. A recent regulatory program enacted by the Central Coast Regional Water Quality Control Board set new pesticide limits for waterways and imposed enhanced enforcement mechanisms to help ensure that water quality targets are met by specific dates. This regulatory program, however, does not mandate specific changes to pest management programs. In this study, we evaluate the economic, environmental, and pest management impacts of adopting two alternative pest management programs with reduced risks to surface water: 1) replacing currently used insecticide active ingredients (AIs) that pose the greatest risk to surface water with lower-risk alternatives and 2) converting conventional arthropod pest management programs to organic ones. We utilize pesticide use and toxicity data from California's Department of Pesticide Regulation to develop our baseline and two alternative scenarios. We focus on three crop groups (cole crops, lettuce and strawberry) due to their economic importance to the Central Coast and use of high-risk AIs. For Scenario 1, we estimate that implementing the alternative program in the years 2017-2019 would have reduced annual net returns on average by $90.26 - $190.54/ha, depending on the crop. Increased material costs accounted for the greatest share of this effect (71.9%-95.6%). In contrast, Scenario 2 would have reduced annual net returns on average by $5,628.12 - $18,708.28/ha during the study period, with yield loss accounting for the greatest share (92.8-97.9%). Both alternative programs would have reduced the associated toxic units by at least 98.1% compared to the baseline scenario. Our analysis provides important guidance for policymakers and agricultural producers looking to achieve environmental protection goals while minimizing economic impacts.
abstract_zh: 农药对保护农作物至关重要，但农药通过喷雾漂移和径流发生的场外迁移，给地表水和水生生物带来风险。加利福尼亚中部海岸地区是美国的主要农业中心，其特点是全年生产并大量使用农药及其他化学投入品。因此，该地区许多水体的水质已经退化。中部海岸地区水质控制委员会（Central Coast Regional Water Quality Control Board）近期颁布的一项监管计划，为水道设定了新的农药限值，并实施了强化的执法机制，以确保水质目标在特定日期前达成。然而，该监管计划并未强制要求改变病虫害管理方案。在本研究中，我们评估了采用两种降低地表水风险的替代病虫害管理方案所带来的经济、环境和病虫害管理影响：1）以风险较低的替代品取代目前使用的、对地表水风险最大的杀虫剂活性成分（AIs）；2）将常规节肢动物病虫害管理方案转变为有机方案。我们利用加利福尼亚农药管理局的农药使用和毒性数据，构建了基准情形和两种替代情景。由于十字花科蔬菜（甘蓝类）、生菜和草莓对中部海岸地区具有重要经济意义，且使用了高风险活性成分，我们聚焦于这三类作物群组。对于情景1，我们估计，若在2017–2019年实施替代方案，每年平均净收益将减少每公顷90.26至190.54美元，具体取决于作物。材料成本增加占这一影响的最大份额（71.9%–95.6%）。相比之下，情景2将使研究期间的年均净收益减少每公顷5,628.12至18,708.28美元，其中减产占最大份额（92.8%–97.9%）。两种替代方案都会使相关毒性单位与基准情景相比至少减少98.1%。我们的分析为决策者和农业生产者提供了重要指导，帮助他们在实现环境保护目标的同时，将经济影响降到最低。

venue: Agricultural Productivity and Producer Behavior, NBER/University of Chicago Press
abstract: Crop diseases and how they are managed can have a large impact on agricultural productivity. This paper discusses the effects on agricultural productivity of Verticillium dahliae, a soil borne fungus that is introduced to the soil via infested spinach seeds and that causes subsequent lettuce crops to be afflicted with Verticillium wilt. We use a dynamic structural econometric model of Verticillium wilt management for lettuce crops in Monterey County, California to examine the effects of Verticillium wilt on crop-fumigation decisions and on grower welfare. We also discuss our research on the externalities that arise with renters, and between seed companies and growers due to Verticillium wilt, as these disease-related externalities have important implications for agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 作物病害及其管理方式可能对农业生产力产生重大影响。本文探讨了黄萎病菌（Verticillium dahliae）对农业生产力的影响。这种土传真菌通过受感染的菠菜种子进入土壤，导致随后种植的生菜感染黄萎病。我们利用加利福尼亚州蒙特雷县生菜黄萎病管理的动态结构计量经济模型，考察黄萎病对土壤熏蒸决策及种植者福利的影响。我们还讨论了我们关于租户以及种子公司与种植者之间因黄萎病而产生的外部性的研究，因为这些与病害相关的外部性对农业生产力具有重要影响。

Farmgate Prices, Retail Prices and Supermarkets' Pricing Decisions: an Integrated Approach
abstract: Agricultural and food prices exhibit several empirical regularities that are not easily explained by conventional perfect competition or market power models, including asymmetric price transmission, food price rigidity, farmgate price volatility, and low correlation between prices at different stages of the supply chain. We focus on this set of market features and conclude that they can be the outcome of a competition model where supermarket use promotions to strategically attract basket shoppers. We present a numerical simulation to show that complex price patterns including all the features indicated above can be obtained from a general store traffic competition model without the need of introducing ad hoc assumptions. [EconLit citations: Q11, Q13].
abstract_zh: 农产品和食品价格呈现出若干经验规律，传统的完全竞争或市场势力模型难以轻易解释，包括价格的非对称传导、食品价格刚性、农场门口价格波动，以及供应链不同环节价格之间的低相关性。我们聚焦于这一组市场特征，并认为它们可能是一种竞争模型的结果：超市利用促销来战略性地吸引购物篮顾客。我们进行了数值模拟，表明无需引入特设假设，仅从一般的店铺客流竞争模型即可得出包含上述全部特征的复杂价格模式。[EconLit分类号：Q11, Q13]。

title: The Economic Viability of Suppressive Crop Rotations for the Control of Verticillium Wilt in Organic Strawberry Production
abstract: Soil-borne diseases and nitrogen availability are important limits on organic strawberry production. A trial using suppressive crop rotations to combat Verticillium wilt was conducted to see its effects on strawberry yields and net returns using a split-split-plot design. An ANOVA analysis was run to understand determinants of net returns. Results show that the suppression of wilt through the planting of non-host crops such as broccoli before the planting of strawberries can have significant effects on yield and net returns, and that suppressive crop rotations are potentially commercially viable.
abstract_zh: 土传病害和氮素有效性是有机草莓生产的重要限制因素。我们采用裂区设计（split-split-plot design）开展了一项试验，利用抑制性轮作防治黄萎病，以考察其对草莓产量和净收益的影响。我们进行了方差分析（ANOVA），以探究净收益的决定因素。结果表明，在种植草莓之前种植西兰花等非寄主作物，能够抑制黄萎病，并对产量和净收益产生显著影响；抑制性轮作在商业上可能是可行的。

Agricultural Contracts, Adverse Selection, and Multiple Inputs
abstract: A significant and growing share of US agricultural output is produced under a production or marketing contract. An important controversy regarding agricultural production contracts is the control of non-labor inputs. Over time, contracts have tended to place more inputs under the buyer’s control and fewer under the farmer’s. This analysis examines the welfare effects of this trend. In the framework considered here, returns are reduced for some farmers and left unaffected for others. Returns to the buyer increase. The net effect on total surplus has two components. Output is higher when the buyer controls the input, due to lower information rents accruing to more productive farmers. However, this reduction distorts input use away from the production cost-minimizing level, which is costly. The net effect on total surplus depends primarily on the elasticity of substitution between inputs. Given the limited substitutability between labor and non-labor inputs in many agricultural activities, the analysis suggests that greater control of non-labor inputs by the buyer increases total surplus. The increase in returns to the buyer is consistent with the growing share of output produced under vertical coordination and the tendency to specify a greater number of production activities rather than allowing farmers to make their own decisions. The reduction in the returns obtained by some farmers is consistent with farmers’ opposition to such requirements.
abstract_zh: 美国农业产出中，通过生产或营销合同实现的份额日益增长，且占比显著。关于农业生产合同的一个重要争议，在于对非劳动投入的控制权。随着时间推移，合同越来越多地将投入置于买方控制之下，而由农民自主决定的投入越来越少。本文考察了这一趋势的福利效应。在本文所考虑的框架中，部分农民的收益减少，其他农民的收益则不受影响。买方的收益增加。对总剩余的净效应包含两个组成部分。当买方控制投入时产出更高，因为生产率较高的农民所获得的信息租金更低。然而，这种削减会使投入使用偏离生产成本最小化的水平，而这是有代价的。总剩余的净效应主要取决于投入之间的替代弹性。鉴于许多农业活动中劳动与非劳动投入之间的替代性有限，分析表明，买方对非劳动投入的更多控制会增加总剩余。买方收益的增加，与纵向协调下产出占比的上升，以及合同倾向于规定更多生产活动而非允许农民自主决策的趋势相一致。部分农民收益的减少，则与农民对此类要求的反对相一致。

Modeling Negotiations over Water and Ecosystem Management
abstract: We present a modeling approach for generating robust predictions about how changes in institutional, economic, and political considerations will influence the outcome of political negotiations over complex water-ecosystem policy debates. Evaluating the political viability of proposed policies is challenging for researchers in these complex natural and political environments; there is limited information with which to map policies to outcomes to utilities or to represent the political process adequately. Our analysis evaluates the viability of policy options using a probabilistic political viability criterion that explicitly recognizes the existence of modeling uncertainty. The approach is used to conduct a detailed case study of the future of California’s Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta. Several other possible applications of the approach are briefly discussed.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种建模方法，用于对制度、经济和政治因素的变化如何影响复杂的水生态系统政策辩论中政治谈判的结果进行稳健预测。在这些复杂的自然与政治环境中评估拟议政策的政治可行性，对研究者而言颇具挑战：可用于将政策映射到结果、映射到效用，或充分刻画政治过程的信息十分有限。我们的分析采用一种概率化的政治可行性标准来评估政策选项，该标准明确承认建模不确定性的存在。该方法被用于对加利福尼亚萨克拉门托—圣华金三角洲未来的详细案例研究。文中还简要讨论了该方法的其他若干可能应用。

Managing a Pest with Harvest Timing: Implications for Crop Quality and Price
abstract: This article examines a case in which growers' pest management decisions collectively generate a change in price that reduces the losses from infestation for some but further harms others. Olive growers in California control the olive fruit fly not only by spraying insecticides but also by harvesting olives earlier, sacrificing quality and altering the industry's fruit quality distribution. Growers of higher quality fruit alter harvest timing the most, benefiting from the resulting change in the quality premium at the expense of growers of lower quality fruit. Across the industry, the change in the quality premium leads to greater reliance on chemical control.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了这样一个案例：种植者的病虫害管理决策共同导致价格变化，这一变化减少了部分种植者的虫害损失，却进一步损害了另一些种植者。加利福尼亚的橄榄种植者不仅通过喷洒杀虫剂，还通过提前采收来控制橄榄实蝇，从而牺牲了品质，并改变了该行业的果实品质分布。高品质果实的种植者对采收时间的调整幅度最大，他们因品质溢价的变化而受益，代价则由低品质果实的种植者承担。在整个行业范围内，品质溢价的变化导致对化学防治的依赖性上升。

abstract: Most agricultural policy analysis assumes that markets are perfectly competitive, despite increasing evidence to the contrary. We demonstrate that the interaction of market power and government intervention may lead to outcomes that are counter to key results of policy analysis for perfectly competitive markets. We show that market power may reduce or eliminate entirely the net welfare benefits from removing two traditional support mechanisms, price floors and deficiency payments, and may increase considerably the government's cost of implementing either of them. Accordingly, optimally designed price support measures may improve welfare in the presence of downstream oligopoly and/or oligopsony power.
abstract_zh: 大多数农业政策分析假定市场是完全竞争的，尽管越来越多的证据表明并非如此。我们证明，市场势力与政府干预的相互作用，可能导致与完全竞争市场政策分析的关键结论相悖的结果。我们表明，市场势力可能会降低甚至完全消除取消两种传统支持机制（价格下限和差额补贴）所带来的净福利收益，并可能显著提高政府实施其中任一机制的成本。因此，在存在下游寡头和/或买方寡头势力的情况下，经过优化设计的价格支持措施可能改善福利。

title: Management and Yield Impact of the Greenhouse Whitefly (Trialeurodes vaporariorum) on California Strawberries
abstract:
Reductions in strawberry yields were observed in association with infestations of the greenhouse whitefly,
Trialeurodes vaporariorum
(Westwood). The magnitude of yield impact is estimated using data from a field experiment evaluating nine management approaches for the greenhouse whitefly on strawberries, var. Camarosa. A range of effectiveness and yields was found. Imidacloprid (Admire) applied at transplanting was found to provide the greatest effect on adult whitefly densities. Pyriproxyfen (Esteem) had no immediate effect on adult density but reduced nymphal densities over time. Pairing the use of these products at transplant (Admire) and early spring (Esteem) provided the greatest reduction in whitefly density observed relative to an untreated control. Reductions in strawberry yields were found to increase as whitefly densities grow or as populations persist over time. For example, the estimates from our analysis suggest that at 20 weeks after planting, an average whitefly population may reduce average weekly yields in an untreated field by ≈80 g/plant.
abstract_zh: 草莓产量的下降与温室粉虱（Trialeurodes vaporariorum，Westwood）的侵害有关。本文利用一项田间试验数据估算产量影响的程度，该试验评估了九种针对草莓（品种 Camarosa）温室粉虱的防治方法。不同防治措施的效果和产量存在较大差异。定植时施用吡虫啉（Admire）对成虫密度的效果最为显著。吡丙醚（Esteem）对成虫密度没有即时效果，但会随时间推移降低若虫密度。在定植时使用 Admire、在早春使用 Esteem 进行组合施用，相对于未处理的对照，粉虱密度下降幅度最大。研究发现，粉虱密度越高或种群持续时间越长，草莓减产幅度越大。例如，本文分析的估计结果表明，定植后20周，若未处理的田块中粉虱种群处于平均水平，则每株草莓的平均每周产量将减少约80克。

venue: Vertical Relationships and Coordination in the Food System, Physica-Verlag
abstract: Many believe that the American agrofood chain is shifting from a commodity system organized via spot markets to a vertically coordinated food product system (Drabenstott, 1994). Precision techniques have become more important at all levels of the vertical production chain and have enabled more cost-effective production and improved quality control. This has facilitated serving consumer niche markets with specialized products. Exponentially-improving information technology has facilitated and possibly driven this change. Biotechnology has contributed to the ability to control product attributes and has lowered production costs. Changes in the exercise of control and the distribution of risk and rents have occurred as well. The simultaneity of these changes and their fundamental importance for the nature and organization of the agrofood chain has made this agricultural transformation a primary agricultural policy concern. In spite of its importance, the nature of the transformation process is not well-understood. These keywords were added by machine and not by the authors. This process is experimental and the keywords may be updated as the learning algorithm improves.
abstract_zh: 许多学者认为，美国农业食品链正由以现货市场组织的商品体系，转向纵向协调的食品产品体系（Drabenstott, 1994）。精准技术在纵向生产链的各个环节都变得愈发重要，使生产成本更加有效，并提高了质量控制水平。这促使企业能够面向消费者的细分市场提供专门化产品。呈指数级提升的信息技术促进了这一变化，甚至可能是其主要驱动力。生物技术有助于控制产品属性，并降低了生产成本。与此同时，控制权的行使方式以及风险和租金的分配也发生了变化。这些变化同时发生，并且对农业食品链的性质与组织方式具有根本性影响，使这一农业转型成为农业政策的首要关注议题。尽管其重要性不言而喻，这一转型过程的性质目前仍未得到充分理解。这些关键词由机器添加，并非作者所选。该过程仍处于试验阶段，随着学习算法的改进，关键词可能会更新。
